scope: native iOS app; Firebase Hosting requests; excludes unrelated external web-app analytics
basis: Evidence-based classification judgment, not an official Apple mapping for Firebase Hosting.

data_types.description: IP addresses retained by Firebase Hosting
data_types.reason: Raw request IP is retained for months for abuse prevention and usage analysis. No evidence of pre-collection anonymization, location derivation, device-level identification, or specific app diagnostic measurements.

not_declared_on_current_evidence: On-device playback history and language preference
apple_services_boundary: Apple own collection is not developer declaration. If developer collects app data from Apple frameworks/services, declare actual received data and uses. TestFlight upload alone does not establish separate developer collection or export of every feedback/diagnostic field.

sources.supports: Collection definition, IP classified by use, on-device exclusion, linked and tracking definitions, Apple services boundary.
Hosting request IP, abuse detection, usage analysis, retention for a few months.
TestFlight platform collection and developer feedback sharing.

apple_services_current_evidence: No testers assigned and no evidence of separately received/exported TestFlight feedback in this release; reassess when collection practices change.
publication_evidence: Verified in App Store Connect during the 2026-09-07 release session: App Privacy is Published; public privacy and support URLs are saved for both locales.
